info.name: Google Maps Directions Autocomplete Photos API

params.name: maxHeightPx
params.description: Maximum height of the image in pixels. Must be between 1 and 4800. If maxHeightPx is set without maxWidthPx, the image is resized to the specified height, preserving aspect ratio.

params.name: maxWidthPx
params.description: Maximum width of the image in pixels. Must be between 1 and 4800. If maxWidthPx is set without maxHeightPx, the image is resized to the specified width, preserving aspect ratio.

params.name: skipHttpRedirect
params.description: If set to true, skip the default HTTP redirect behavior and return a JSON response containing the photo URI.

items.docs: Returns a photo for a place. After you get the photo resource name from a Place Details or Search response, use this endpoint to get the photo bytes. Specify maxHeightPx or maxWidthPx (or both) to control the image dimensions.
